periods.glance: Norway, 1906 to 1907. About 2.17 million people in 1906 (estimate). Ruling party: Coalition Party (Christian Michelsen). Leaders: Christian Michelsen, Haakon VII of Norway, Jørgen Løvland. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1908 to 1910. About 2.2 million people in 1908 (estimate). Ruling party: Liberal Party (Jørgen Løvland). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Jørgen Løvland, Gunnar Knudsen and others. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1911 to 1912. About 2.25 million people in 1911 (estimate). Ruling party: Free-minded Liberal Party (Wollert Konow). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Wollert Konow, Jens Bratlie. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1913. About 2.29 million people in 1913 (estimate). Ruling party: Conservative Party of Norway (Jens Bratlie). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Jens Bratlie, Gunnar Knudsen. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1914 to 1920. About 2.31 million people in 1914 (estimate). Ruling party: Liberal Party (Gunnar Knudsen). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Gunnar Knudsen, Otto Bahr Halvorsen. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1921. About 2.31 million to 2.67 million people in 1921 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Conservative Party of Norway (Otto Bahr Halvorsen). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Otto Bahr Halvorsen, Otto Blehr. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1922 to 1923. About 2.32 million to 2.7 million people in 1922 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Liberal Party (Otto Blehr). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Otto Blehr, Abraham Berge and others. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1924. About 2.35 million to 2.73 million people in 1924 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Free-minded Liberal Party (Abraham Berge). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Abraham Berge, Johan Ludwig Mowinckel. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1925 to 1926. About 2.36 million to 2.75 million people in 1925 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Liberal Party (Johan Ludwig Mowinckel). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Johan Ludwig Mowinckel, Ivar Lykke. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1927 to 1928. About 2.39 million to 2.78 million people in 1927 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Conservative Party of Norway (Ivar Lykke). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Ivar Lykke, Christopher Hornsrud and others. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1929 to 1931. About 2.42 million to 2.8 million people in 1929 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Liberal Party (Johan Ludwig Mowinckel). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Johan Ludwig Mowinckel, Peder Kolstad. Movements: Greater Finland.

Norway, 1932 to 1933. About 2.46 million to 2.84 million people in 1932 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Centre Party (Peder Kolstad). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Peder Kolstad, Jens Hundseid and others.

Norway, 1934 to 1935. About 2.49 million to 2.87 million people in 1934 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Liberal Party (Johan Ludwig Mowinckel). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Johan Ludwig Mowinckel, Johan Nygaardsvold.

Norway, 1936 to 1960. About 2.71 million people in 1936 (estimate). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Johan Nygaardsvold). Leaders: Haakon VII of Norway, Johan Nygaardsvold, Einar Gerhardsen and others.

Norway, 1961 to 1965. About 3.08 million to 3.61 million people in 1961 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Einar Gerhardsen). Leaders: Einar Gerhardsen, Olav V of Norway, John Lyng and others.
Norway, 1966 to 1971. About 3.21 million to 3.75 million people in 1966 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Centre Party (Per Borten). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Per Borten, Trygve Bratteli.
Norway, 1972. About 3.34 million to 3.93 million people in 1972 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Trygve Bratteli). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Trygve Bratteli, Lars Korvald.
Norway, 1973. About 3.35 million to 3.96 million people in 1973 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Christian Democratic Party (Lars Korvald). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Lars Korvald, Trygve Bratteli.

Norway, 1974 to 1981. About 3.37 million to 3.99 million people in 1974 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Trygve Bratteli). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Trygve Bratteli, Odvar Nordli and others.

Norway, 1982 to 1986. About 3.49 million to 4.11 million people in 1982 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Conservative Party of Norway (Kåre Willoch). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Kåre Willoch, Gro Harlem Brundtland.

Norway, 1987 to 1989. About 3.56 million to 4.19 million people in 1987 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Gro Harlem Brundtland). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Gro Harlem Brundtland, Jan P. Syse.

Norway, 1990. About 3.59 million to 4.24 million people in 1990 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Conservative Party of Norway (Jan P. Syse). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Jan P. Syse, Gro Harlem Brundtland.

Norway, 1991 to 1997. About 3.61 million to 4.26 million people in 1991 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Gro Harlem Brundtland). Leaders: Olav V of Norway, Gro Harlem Brundtland, Harald V of Norway and others.

Norway, 1998 to 2000. About 3.75 million to 4.43 million people in 1998 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Christian Democratic Party (Kjell Magne Bondevik). Leaders: Harald V of Norway, Kjell Magne Bondevik, Jens Stoltenberg.

Norway, 2001. About 3.82 million to 4.52 million people in 2001 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Jens Stoltenberg). Leaders: Harald V of Norway, Jens Stoltenberg, Kjell Magne Bondevik.

Norway, 2002 to 2005. About 3.85 million to 4.54 million people in 2002 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Christian Democratic Party (Kjell Magne Bondevik). Leaders: Harald V of Norway, Kjell Magne Bondevik, Jens Stoltenberg.
Norway, 2006 to 2009. About 3.98 million to 4.66 million people in 2006 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Jens Stoltenberg). Leaders: Harald V of Norway, Jens Stoltenberg.

Norway, 2010 to 2013: unitary state, parliamentary system. About 4.11 million to 4.89 million people in 2010 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Norwegian Labour Party (Jens Stoltenberg). Leaders: Harald V of Norway, Jens Stoltenberg, Erna Solberg.

Norway, 2014 to 2019: unitary state, parliamentary system. About 4.27 million to 5.14 million people in 2014 (estimates differ). Ruling party: Conservative Party of Norway (Erna Solberg). Leaders: Harald V of Norway, Erna Solberg.
